Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the question by treating “Chian Hsiao-chang’s father” as Chiang Kai-shek (her grandfather) and answered with his other child (Chiang Wei-kuo). The father is actually Chiang Ching-kuo, who had multiple children, so the “other child” is not singular; this led to the wrong conclusion.
